items.title: Richard Gere and Diane Lane in Infidelidad (2002)
RICHARD GERE and DIANE LANE portray a couple living in the New York city suburbs whose marriage goes dangerously awry when the wife indulges in an adulterous fling in UNFAITHFUL.
